result.title: VASR: Vector-Aware Assembly Planning with Equivalent Structures and Repair-Cost Feedback
result.summary: Furniture assembly planning requires inferring subassembly hierarchies from individual parts and a target illustration. Existing raster-based methods do not explicitly exploit the geometric and structural information in SVG drawings. We introduce VASR, a framework that fuses features from a dedicated SVG encoder with visual representations from a pretrained vision-language model to predict assembly hierarchies. To avoid penalizing valid alternatives to a reference assembly tree, we propose Repair-Aware Hierarchical Policy Optimization (RHPO) with hierarchy-preserving equivalence rewards. RHPO further uses repair-cost feedback to favor decisions with lower downstream correction costs among candidates with comparable equivalence-aware rewards. VASR achieves the highest Equivalent-Hard F1 among the evaluated methods, outperforming GPT6-Astra by 17.69 percentage points on the IKEA-derived test set while maintaining strong performance on an independent furniture dataset.

AI.brief_summary: VASR 将专用 SVG 编码器与预训练 VLM 的视觉表示融合，用于从零件和目标图示推断家具装配层级，并提出带层级保持等价奖励的 RHPO，用修复代价在等价性相当的候选间做二次择优。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“多解等价”奖励与修复代价排序可能为 LVR 中多条 latent 推理路径的等价监督和按下游修正成本重排候选提供借鉴线索，但任务本身与视觉推理机制距离较远，需核查。
